description: Penalty rules for 2030B P2P. Managed by super-admin. Loaded by admin panel + applied client-side via B30Store.adjustUserCredits().

user_fake_pairing.label: User submitted a fake pairing
user_fake_pairing.description: Deducts 5 credits from a user whose pairing was confirmed fake by an admin.

user_fake_op.label: User submitted a fake single op
user_fake_op.description: Deducts 2 credits when a single P2P op is found fake.

user_repeat_offender.label: Repeat offender (3+ rejected items)
user_repeat_offender.description: Heavy penalty for users with 3+ rejected fake submissions.

admin_wrong_approve.label: Admin wrongly approved a fake submission
admin_wrong_approve.description: Reputational penalty (credits-as-trust) when a sub-admin approves a fake item that is later overturned by super-admin.

admin_wrong_reject.label: Admin wrongly rejected a legit submission
admin_wrong_reject.description: Penalty for unjustified rejections that are later reversed by super-admin.

admin_inactive.label: Admin inactive for too long
admin_inactive.description: Auto-disable admins inactive for 30+ days. Super-admin can re-enable.
